description: Generate a budgeted Markdown brief of the repository (risks, hotspots, structure) to read before editing, especially in an unfamiliar codebase. Use it for orientation. For the full findings as JSON, use repopilot_scan; to review a change, use repopilot_review_change. Pass `analysis_handle` to make sure the brief still matches an earlier scan or review. Built locally from a scan; no AI service is called and nothing is uploaded.

analysis_handle.description: Optional `analysisHandle` from an earlier repopilot_scan or repopilot_review_change call. The call fails if the workspace changed since that analysis.

budget.description: Optional approximate token budget for the brief. Defaults to the standard budget.

config.description: Optional repopilot.toml path. Defaults to the one discovered in the repository.

focus.description: Optional focus: security, architecture (or arch), quality, framework, or all.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to the current working directory.

profile.description: "default" hides low-signal suggestions; "strict" includes all findings.

name: repopilot_context

change_proof.description: Canonical ChangeProof from the referenced review handle, when selected.

decision.description: Canonical primary review decision and next action from the referenced review handle, when selected.

evidence.description: Canonical evidence class, coverage, and provenance from the referenced review handle, when selected.
